data.text: Before we choose, can we agree on a shared limit? I propose 17 tons each this month: that’s 85 total, leaving 15. Next month we’d have 100 tons with 75% probability or 30 tons with 25% probability—not a guaranteed refill. If we start a month below 100, we should agree on lower whole-ton quotas before fishing, always leaving at least 5 tons. We can rotate any extra tons so everyone gets a fair share over time. I’m willing to stick to 17 if we all commit. John, would you agree?
